reason: Paying only when I'm happy is nice, but nothing tells me what I'll be paying every month after launch for hosting, the domain or someone to fix things, and SEO at £325 a month on top is more than I'd spend. They hand me the logins and walk off, and I don't have time to look after a website myself.
objection: The hidden monthly costs after it goes live, and who actually looks after it when something breaks, especially a company in Kuwait I've never heard of with no reviews.
would_change_my_mind: One fixed, all-in price that includes hosting, domain and small updates for a low set monthly fee, written down, so I never have to touch the tech.
